thread:
Maria Chen: Alert from SecDetector: unusual KMS decrypt activity for key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/customer-data` by principal `serviceAccount:build-bot-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. spike starting 2026-03-19T21:12Z. Requesting immediate containment.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Incident created: INC-20260319-042. Pager duty notified.

Sahil Patel: Copy. Maria, can you paste the raw audit log snippet and originating IPs?

Maria Chen: Paste logs:
```
2026-03-19T21:12:07Z - decrypt - principal: build-bot-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - ip: 54.210.12.34 - resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/customer-data - status: OK
2026-03-19T21:12:11Z - decrypt - principal: build-bot-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - ip: 54.210.12.34 - count: 130
```
Looks like one external IP, repeated calls. Could be compromised CI token.

Priya Rao: Escalating: block service account keys and create short-lived replacement. Steps:
1) Disable SA keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=build-bot-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
2) Revoke tokens: remove sessions in IAM console
3) Rotate KMS primary by creating a new key version: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=customer-data --location=global --keyring=primary` then set primary.

Ops SRE: Also add network block for the IP at edge load balancers and firewall.
Command to add ip block in firewall rule (GCP):
```
gcloud compute firewall-rules update fw-deny-external --add-src-ranges=54.210.12.34/32
```

Sahil Patel: Running the disable now.
`gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable abc123 --iam-account=build-bot-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
... returned 200

Maria Chen: Key disable confirmed. KMS primary rotate queued, creating new key version now.

Ops SRE: Audit log shows no other principals from that IP. I started a full credential scan across CI runners for leaked tokens. Will post results.

Julian Reyes: Taking 30m to validate rotation and reconfigure CI. @Priya Rao, leaving a checklist for night on-call. Handoff at 22:10Z.

Priya Rao: Handoff notes:
- Compromised SA keys disabled.
- Firewall rules updated to block 54.210.12.34.
- KMS new key version created; set as primary at 21:35Z.
- CI pipelines paused for projects `ingest` and `build`.
- Next steps: full token sweep, contact cloud provider to request IP abuse track, prepare customer-facing statement if data confirmed exposed.

oncall-bot: Handoff assigned to Julian Reyes. Incident severity set to P1.

Julian Reyes: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate midnight shift and update status channel with timeline. Adding this to incident board: https://incident.redwood.internal/INC-20260319-042

Maria Chen: Logged timeline and evidence into ticket. Will follow up with post-incident root-cause and suggested RBAC hardening (minimize SA scopes, rotate keys weekly, read-only keys for build jobs).

Priya Rao: closing initial containment window. Leaving notes for postmortem owner: @Priya Rao
